name: JW Marriott Essex House New York

address.street: 160 Central Park South; New York City

insider_take: This Art Deco masterpiece has been the sophisticated choice for discerning travelers since 1931, offering unparalleled Central Park views from the heart of Manhattan.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Essex House sits directly across from Central Park on "Billionaire's Row" along Central Park South. This historic landmark features original 1930s Art Deco architecture and has hosted everyone from royalty to Hollywood legends. The hotel's prime location puts you steps from Lincoln Center, Carnegie Hall, and the Theater District, while offering some of the city's most coveted park-facing suites.
pro_tip: Request a Central Park-facing room above the 15th floor for breathtaking treetop views and iconic skyline vistas that showcase the park's seasonal transformations.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to Central Park's Wollman Rink (winter ice skating, summer amusement park) and the exclusive shopping along Fifth Avenue's "Museum Mile." The building's own Art Deco lobby is a photo-worthy destination, and you're just a 2-minute walk to the horse-drawn carriage rides at Grand Army Plaza.
pros: Prime Central Park South location with stunning park views
Art Deco architectural elegance and timeless sophistication
Spacious luxury suites with premium amenities
White-glove concierge service and personalized guest attention
cons: Premium Manhattan pricing reflects luxury positioning
Historic building layout may vary between room configurations
